item.title: 【Live Audios (lossless)】WAV - Judas Priest + Alice Cooper + Corrosion Of Conformity @ Kia Forum 2025-10-19 (raw wavs)
item.description:
Hidden Content:
You must either reply or click 'Like' to see the hidden information contained here.
I wasn't really feeling it but I wasn't really feeling it when they played together July 12, 1991 and I have carried the heavy burden of regret for two thirds of my life.

Once again Alice Cooper's set had it's moments and I knew it was a new show but so much of that stuff I just can't get into, so the big draw is to see what different songs he does. It seems like a Live Nation AI generated setlist calculated to sell the most concessions.

It was also planning on watching the Judas Priest setlist unfold live but I just had to watch Hellfest. I thought they were the best and even COC was great. Also had a ride to Chula Vista but I think I made the right choice just going to 1 show.

9200 sold. Somehow fumbled a $20 ticket and ended up paying $50. Just didn't have the energy to work it like I usually do. Kinda worth it if not for the drunks a few seats over yelling their head off. They didn't belong in those seats. Neither did I. I had found some empty seats 225 row 5 with the sidefills pointing right at me.
